top_signals.title: Bill Gates warns ‘there is no plan’ for the ‘upheaval’ AI will cause
top_signals.summary: Bill Gates warned governments are not adequately preparing for how AI could displace workers, strain social systems and create global risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
